Case No.: Specific Plan Amendment No. SPA-2018-01 Applicant: City of Azusa
Location: Citywide
A request by the City of Azusa for the approval of a Specific Plan Amendment to the Azusa Transit Oriented Development Specific Plan. The City Council adopted the TOD Specific Plan on 10/19/15. The City is amending sections of the TOD Specific Plan on Private Open Space Requirements, Common Open Space Requirements, Minimum Dwelling Unit Size, and Parking Space Dimensions.
Copies of the Specific Plan and Final Environmental Impact report (FEIR) are available on the Cityâ€™s website at www.ci.azusa.ca.us; at the Azusa City Hall, Community Development Department, 213 E.
